  T_6=(1),\quad T_7=(-1),\quad

## Strategy
The degree orders are
\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c}
d&G_L&G_R\\\hline
6&(222)&(222)\\
7&(2221)&(322)\\
8&(2222,22211)&(422,332)\\
9&(22221)&(432)\\
10&(22222)&(442).
\end{array}
\]
The provisional degree-\(6\) through \(9\) determinants are \(1,-1,-1,-1\), hence their Smith diagonals are respectively \((1),(1),(1,1),(1)\). In the stated orders, \(T_8\) is a permutation matrix, not unitriangular; therefore the natural listed ordering does not give dominance-unitriangularity.

## Gaps
The requested target is **not established**. The only attempted computation of the degree-\(10\) transition produced nonintegral coordinates under a rational free-variable choice and terminated with an assertion failure. No successful task-owned computation or integral determinant/Smith certificate for \(T_{10}\), and hence no complete global transition matrix or fully certified dominance-unitriangularity test, is available.
